# Decypharr v2.7 - Synology native packages

This release refreshes the native Synology DSM/SRM package line on upstream Decypharr v2.7.

Synology-specific compatibility retained:
- DSM 7.3 and SRM 1.3 native SPK matrix
- package-local go-fuse 2.5.1 compatibility for older Synology kernels
- optional NotifyPrune disabled only in the Synology packaging copy
- automatic FUSE helper permission repair
- runtime ownership repair for config/auth/torrents JSON state
- Radarr/Sonarr Move import compatibility
- group-writable symlink directories
- rejection of empty symlink jobs

The normal upstream Linux/Docker code path remains unchanged.
